import sys

def main():
    # Define discount percentages as constants (macros equivalent)
    BRONZE_DISCOUNT = 5
    SILVER_DISCOUNT = 10
    GOLD_DISCOUNT = 15
    PLATINUM_DISCOUNT = 20
    
    # Read inputs
    bill_amount = float(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    membership_level = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    
    # Apply conditional compilation logic using if-elif-else chain
    if membership_level == 1:
        discount_percent = BRONZE_DISCOUNT
        level_name = "Bronze"
    elif membership_level == 2:
        discount_percent = SILVER_DISCOUNT
        level_name = "Silver"
    elif membership_level == 3:
        discount_percent = GOLD_DISCOUNT
        level_name = "Gold"
    elif membership_level == 4:
        discount_percent = PLATINUM_DISCOUNT
        level_name = "Platinum"
    
    # Calculate final price
    discount_amount = bill_amount * (discount_percent / 100)
    final_price = bill_amount - discount_amount
    
    # Output results
    print(f"{level_name} Membership: {discount_percent}% Discount")
    print(f"Final Price: {final_price:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
